item.title: PODCAST 🎧 Paris Calling, Ep.8 | Lu Min, Nanjing — Chinese Fiction & Universal Truths
item.description: Nanjing-based Chinese novelist Lu Min walks us through her journey before and after becoming a writer — and how her work explores one of the most transformative eras of social change in China.

item.title: Cheap Nails, Hidden Chains: Human Trafficking Inside Berlin’s Nail Salons
item.description: Investigators warn that low-cost manicures in Berlin and across German cities are often sustained by labor exploitation and human trafficking networks, particularly involving Vietnamese workers.

item.title: Latin America Edges Back Toward Taiwan, Amid Doubts About China’s Influence
item.description: In several Latin American countries, there is renewed interest and advocacy to reactivate bilateral ties with Taiwan, after years of broken political promises and economic contracts.

item.title: Bondi Beach, And How Not To Respond To An Anti-Semitic Attack
item.description: The anti-Semitic attack on Bondi Beach has given rise to unnecessary controversy at a time when we should be united against this scourge and showing compassion for the victims. The resurgence of anti-Semitism around the world is too serious to be used as a political ploy, especially by the Israeli prime minister

item.title: Gifted And Exhausting? It’s Not Always Simple To Love A Brilliant Partner
item.description: Their brains are wired differently, and those living with a "High Intellectual Potential" individual can be a daily challenge. Sometimes, intellectual intensity is accompanied by a destabilizing emotional hypersensitivity.

item.title: After Assad: With The Syrian Refugees Fleeing To Russia
item.description: After Assad fled to Russia, Moscow opened the door for asylum and humanitarian protection to many Syrians, including former military members. Yet their journeys north are very different.

item.title: Along A Favorite Black Forest Hike, Where Schnapps Sets The Pace
item.description: On the Brennersteig trail, a German journalist follows a route lined with orchards, distilleries, and endless tiny temptations, discovering how easily a simple hike becomes a pilgrimage from one bottle to the next.

item.title: “War Itself” — Inside NATO’s New Stance On Russian Hybrid Attacks
item.description: NATO’s warning signals a shift in how Europe must confront Russian cyber attacks, sabotage, and pressure on critical infrastructure, as Moscow turns sub-threshold conflict into a strategic weapon.

item.title: Grandma And Me? Taiwan’s Gen Z Already Bears The Weight Of An Aging Society
item.description: It used to be that Taiwan's multi-generational family lived together and cared for each other. Low birthrates and rising economic pain are reformulating the equation for all.
